name: Banana wine
summary: Banana wine, also distilled by the Thai hosts, is poured beside the corn wine at the summit camp.
origin: The summit camp, Pù Luông. Source: VietNamNet, 16 Nov 2025.
howToEat: At the camp supper, beside the corn wine.
where: The summit camp on the two-day trek.
seoTitle: Banana wine at the Pu Luong summit camp
seoDescription: Rượu chuối is banana wine the Thai hosts distill and pour at the Pù Luông summit camp.
